name: aes_sbox_depth4_33and
detail: BDD path sum reached the normal form for all inputs and outcomes (33 measurements, 99 H, 66 HH, 0 omega; 18805 BDD nodes)
reference_how: copied from the development project; checked against an independent definition (AES tables)
wires: q[0..7] = x (bit i = coefficient of x^i, AES field GF(2^8)/x^8+x^4+x^3+x+1), q[8..15] = y, q[16..43] clean ancillas
note: |x,0> -> |x,S(x)>; 33 AND at AND-depth 4 (published depth-4 designs: 34 AND); 44 qubits, T-depth 13.
